newsitem.title: USA: Ark sees loss in March quarter.
newsitem.headline: Ark sees loss in March quarter.

text.p: Ark Restaurants Corp said Thursday that losses at its Las Vegas operations in January through mid-February will result in a loss for the March quarter.
It said the loss would be "somewhat" -- but not substantially -- above the loss of $0.32 a share reported for the year-earlier period.
"Despite our Las Vegas operations having been open for only 10 weeks, we have been profitable there since mid-February and are encouraged by these recent results," said Michael Weinstein, president.
He added, "Ark's March quarter is historically the worst for our company."

If New York-New York Hotel & Casino, its Las Vegas operation, had opened in mid-December as originally planned, a major part of Ark's initial operating costs would have been reported in the December quarter.
"However, with the opening behind us, we expect Las Vegas to be a strong profit contributor in the June quarter," he said.
Revenues from the newly opened hotel and casino complex are running above expectations at an annual rate in excess of $35 million, Ark said.
